notes: All tasks are proposed and unimplemented by this planning task.
Priorities: P0 required for initial release; P1 optional quality improvements gated by ablation; P2 later capability.
Timings and quality/performance targets in the plan are proposals, not measured outcomes.
Existing uncommitted application work must be preserved.

tasks.title: Freeze quality brief and current baselines
acceptance_criteria: Archive current outputs for a 100-photo rights-cleared diagnostic set and record engine/source hashes.
Record Lightroom product/build/settings and use identical rendered inputs for the rendered-image comparison.
Record actual hardware, current latency and peak RSS; no quality-improvement claim before measurement.

tasks.title: Create dataset and model rights ledger
acceptance_criteria: Exclude FiveK and PPR10K images/derived artifacts from production training unless separately licensed.
Archive SIDD MIT statement and actual artifact notices.
Every proposed code/checkpoint/data artifact has exact version, hash, permitted use, obligations and unresolved items.

tasks.title: Build blinded evaluation and grouped split manifests
acceptance_criteria: Pre-register Natural rubric, near-final denominator, severe artifacts, comparison tracks and statistical unit.
Group near-duplicates/shoots before splitting; reserve proposed 400-photo locked holdout without training leakage.
Randomize blinded review, record ties and technical failures, and bootstrap by shoot/scene group.

tasks.title: Implement precision and ICC reference path
acceptance_criteria: Verify tagged/untagged RGB and supported high-bit-depth inputs against color reference patches.
Document encoded versus linear domains and ensure float32 calculation path.
Embed sRGB output ICC while stripping private metadata; unsupported modes fail clearly.

tasks.title: Implement photographic operators
acceptance_criteria: EV multiplication, normalized WB/tint, monotone tone curve and hue-aware chroma operations have numerical references.
Gradient, grayscale, clipping and skin/neutral fixtures expose no reproducible severe artifacts.
Keep legacy v1 renderer unchanged; do not equate old percentages with new units.

tasks.title: Build shared versioned renderer and preview/export identity
acceptance_criteria: One immutable recipe and fixed graph drive preview and export.
Cache keys cover source/engine/model/color domains/overrides/crop/output.
Validate nonlinear-resize differences against full render downsample and preserve full-source mask coordinates.

tasks.title: Extend private artifacts and source metadata lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Reserve bytes atomically for recipes/masks/exports and publish completed artifacts atomically.
Job leases respect fixed expiry/deletion without orphaning files or allowing late result resurrection.
Store source color descriptor and immutable hash without leaking private metadata.

tasks.title: Add strict v2 session and recipe contracts
acceptance_criteria: v1 contracts/presets/sessions remain compatible and engine-pinned.
Reject nonfinite floats, oversized arrays, unknown fields, foreign-session recipe handles and invalid crops.
OpenAPI and generated TypeScript cover selected v2 shapes and revision semantics.

tasks.title: Add bounded CPU jobs and cancellation
acceptance_criteria: 202/status/cancel lifecycle, idempotency, queue bounds, deadline and cleanup have behavior tests.
Parent owns authorization and storage; worker process receives scoped inputs and safe native-runtime startup.
Preview capacity remains available during export; timeout/OOM releases resources and discards partial output.

tasks.title: Implement robust analysis and deterministic enhancement fallback
acceptance_criteria: Whole-frame luminance/color diagnostics plus full-resolution noise/detail samples guide bounded corrections.
Night, sunset, silhouette, monochrome and already-good fixtures preserve intent.
Candidate validation backs off strength on clipping/gamut/artifact failure; neutral result is an allowed fallback.

tasks.title: Integrate editable AI state into the studio
acceptance_criteria: AI recipe/strength and manual overrides are separate and fully undoable.
Re-enhance never compounds; Reset/Reset All and existing crop behavior are explicit.
Ignore late jobs/previews, export accepted revision only, retain auth in memory and show accurate capability/fallback state.

tasks.title: Commission and validate owned expert editing pairs
acceptance_criteria: Start proposed 2000-photo grouped corpus with training/validation/locked-test partitions and documented training rights.
Capture full-resolution Natural targets, already-good examples, alternate acceptable edits for a subset and target color profiles.
Quality-control alignment/crop/compression, rights, duplicate groups and target style before training.

tasks.title: Train bounded controller and residual adaptive LUT baseline
acceptance_criteria: Freeze upstream render domains; fit control pseudo-labels with residual errors and train LUT only for remaining transform.
Identity initialization, bounded controls, regularizers and reproducible configs/checkpoints are recorded.
Use validation for selection and compare ablations to deterministic renderer, not unrelated paper PSNR numbers.

tasks.title: Implement approved predictor inference and LUT interpolation
acceptance_criteria: Reference versus optimized interpolation agrees within declared precision on RGB lattice/ramp tests.
ONNX predictor parity is verified separately from LUT kernel; custom operators are not assumed portable.
Manifest validates artifact hash, preprocessing, color domain, expected shapes, runtime and permitted deployment use.

tasks.title: Benchmark spatial LUT challengers
acceptance_criteria: Train LUTwithBGrid/SVDLUT candidate under matched data/split/output conditions.
Measure quality on backlight/mixed-light slices plus latency/RSS/VRAM and required kernel portability.
Adopt only with demonstrated human gain and runtime feasibility; otherwise retain global baseline and record limitations.

tasks.title: Validate semantic masks and bounded local corrections
acceptance_criteria: Any semantic model has a rights/weight manifest and measured mask quality.
Skin/subject/background masks maintain full-source coordinate consistency, edge feathering and ordered overlap behavior.
Mask ablation improves target slices without leakage/halo/skin-tone failures; SAM2 alone is not treated as a semantic classifier.

tasks.title: Evaluate optional NAFNet denoising and restoration challenger
acceptance_criteria: Use correct task checkpoint, trained color domain, normalization and explicit optional control.
Compare source-scale detail/skin/text/stars/fabrics and reject texture destruction or color shift.
Validate full-frame versus tile/local-statistics behavior and measured memory; try Restormer only when needed.

tasks.title: Complete full-resolution export and detail preview
acceptance_criteria: Render accepted recipe/override/crop revision at source dimensions and attach correct ICC.
Provide source-scale detail preview when restoration is enabled; label any reduced-detail preview.
Strength zero, repeat enhancement, output sharpening and preview/export consistency pass fixtures.

tasks.title: Qualify load, memory, storage retirement and privacy
acceptance_criteria: Record cold/warm stage latency, queue wait, RSS/VRAM and throughput on declared hardware.
Simultaneous uploads/previews/exports/deletion/expiry/restarts do not leak sessions or deadlock.
Cross-session recipes and wrong-revision exports fail; admission is sized from measured peak memory, not request counts alone.

tasks.title: Run locked quality study and decide release
acceptance_criteria: Report near-final rate, preference, finishing time, failures, grouped uncertainty and slice counts against proposed gates.
Compare identical inputs to original, current engine, Lightroom Auto and expert final separately.
Do not claim parity from inconclusive results; enlarge sparse/underpowered samples and fix failed slices before promotion.

tasks.title: Add telemetry, model readiness and rollback runbook
acceptance_criteria: Warmup/self-check and optional model readiness work without request-time downloads.
Observe stage latency, failure/fallback category and engine/model version without image/token/private metadata logs.
Version pins and tested rollback preserve active accepted recipes or return an explicit failure.

tasks.title: Finish compatibility checks and staged canary
acceptance_criteria: Run backend suite, generated contract check, frontend tests/build and relevant e2e after implementation.
Keep existing crop and v1 preset regressions passing; document supported formats, limits and actual fallback behavior.
Promote opt-in/5%/25%/100% stages only after sufficient reviewed exposure; rollback triggers are rehearsed.

tasks.title: Add distributed worker/session prerequisites if scaling is needed
acceptance_criteria: Move shared session authorization, jobs and private artifact lifecycle out of process-local state before multiple web replicas.
Use authenticated queues, scoped storage access, distributed admission and deletion coordination.
Measure idle/active GPU cost and end-to-end throughput before adopting infrastructure.

tasks.title: Implement separate RAW development and pro export track
acceptance_criteria: Camera-specific decode/WB/demosaic/profile/highlight behavior and rawpy worker start method are validated.
Raise upload/pixel limits only after worst-case memory tests; 16-bit export and ICC writing have reference validation.
RAW quality is measured against identical RAW inputs in Lightroom, independently of rendered-image claims.
